sentences.text: Yesterday, the dollar firmed as Fed speakers reinforced expectations of further US rate hikes, with Zacks Investment Research putting the dollar index’s gain over the past 5 days at 0.54%.

sentences.text: Fed Governor Waller favours a 50 basis point December hike unless the Fed signals another increase in January, according to ActionForex.
sentences.story: Fed’s Waller Calls for 50bps December Hike Unless January Increase Is Signaled

sources.headline: Fed’s Waller Calls for 50bps December Hike Unless January Increase Is Signaled

sentences.text: Waller says inflation is spreading and that reversing last year's cuts may not be enough to bring it down, while Warsh argues explicit guidance would limit the Fed's flexibility.

sources.headline: Fed’s Waller Calls for 50bps December Hike Unless January Increase Is Signaled

sentences.text: December pricing still centres on a 25 basis point hike, smaller than the move Waller wants if there's no signal for January.

sentences.text: The Bank of Japan held at 1.25%, but Governor Ueda says further hikes are warranted because financial conditions remain accommodative, ActionForex reports.
sentences.story: BoJ’s Ueda Backs Further Rate Hikes, Warns Against Suppressing Bond Yields

sources.headline: BoJ’s Ueda Backs Further Rate Hikes, Warns Against Suppressing Bond Yields

sentences.text: The BoJ is focused on preventing an overshoot of its 2% inflation target and will assess the proposed food tax cut once the details are final.
sentences.story: BoJ’s Ueda Backs Further Rate Hikes, Warns Against Suppressing Bond Yields

sources.headline: BoJ’s Ueda Backs Further Rate Hikes, Warns Against Suppressing Bond Yields

sentences.text: For Japanese bonds, Ueda warned that volatility could rise if markets see the central bank as financing government spending.

sentences.text: UK headline inflation rose to 3.6% in October, in line with expectations, as motor fuel prices climbed 33.2% from a year earlier, ActionForex reports.
sentences.story: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% as Fuel Prices Surge, Core CPI Holds Steady

sources.headline: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% as Fuel Prices Surge, Core CPI Holds Steady

sentences.text: UK core inflation stayed at 2.8% and services inflation at 3.7%, with easing price growth in restaurants and hotels doing most to pull headline inflation lower.
sentences.story: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% as Fuel Prices Surge, Core CPI Holds Steady

sources.headline: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% as Fuel Prices Surge, Core CPI Holds Steady

sentences.text: Eurozone headline inflation rose to 4.0% in October, matching the preliminary estimate, with energy accounting for 1.89 percentage points of the annual rate, according to ActionForex.
sentences.story: Eurozone Inflation Confirmed at 4.0% as Energy Surges, Core CPI Revised Higher

sources.headline: Eurozone Inflation Confirmed at 4.0% as Energy Surges, Core CPI Revised Higher

sentences.text: Eurozone core inflation was revised up to 2.6% in October, pointing to firmer underlying price pressure as services and non-energy industrial goods inflation edged up.
sentences.story: Eurozone Inflation Confirmed at 4.0% as Energy Surges, Core CPI Revised Higher

sources.headline: Eurozone Inflation Confirmed at 4.0% as Energy Surges, Core CPI Revised Higher

sentences.text: US industry data showed crude inventories up 5.28 million barrels on the week and petrol stocks up 5.12 million, Invezz reports.

sentences.text: Brent fell to $92.21 a barrel after the inventory build, with WTI at $84.60 and disruption in the Strait of Hormuz limiting the decline.
